fields.title: Pages without JavaScript
fields.description: Send public pages as plain HTML and CSS, hydrate the admin, and hydrate single interactive bricks as islands.

data.title: This site does hydrate
data.body: These docs hydrate every page, because your edits live in your browser and have to replace the published content after the page loads. A normal Mortar site saves on the server, so its public pages don't need to.
